points.text: No controlled study of how parameter errors propagate to agent performance.
Weak recall for keyboard/press actions; impact on task categories unanalysed.
Pointer-based video filtering may bias trained model; not analysed.
Manifests (video IDs, timestamps, filtering decisions) not released.
No ablation with OCR enhancements or higher-resolution sampling.
Mobile and non-English UIs out of scope; adaptation not discussed.
Cross-dataset comparison table misses important datasets.
Test-time scaling details missing.
Only one vision-language model; generality of improvements untested.
Reliability of LLM-generated inner monologues not analysed; no human study.
Temporal overlap threshold for detection hit unstated.
Undefined abbreviation and typo.
Full video corpus and trajectory annotations not released.
Potential leakage between tutorial data and benchmarks not quantified.
Weaknesses deferred to questions; none stated.
Privacy, licensing, PII handling and creator consent essentially unaddressed.
Whether the corpus will be released is unclear.
Near-optimal tutorial demos contain few recoveries, contradicting persistence claim.
Keystroke-heavy workflows under-represented due to poor press recall.
OS composition of video corpus unreported despite Ubuntu benchmark.
Data from ~50 channels; scaling may reflect few creators' styles.
15.78% success is low relative to 'high-quality supervision' claim.
'Cost-effective' claim without cost accounting.
No limitations or broader-impact discussion of misuse.
Stage-1 gain confounded with extra tokens, compute and GPT-5 text.
'Unsupervised' claim contradicted by supervised IDM, human Stage 2, LLM labelling.
Test-time scaling and subgoal claims from one run without behaviour analysis.
Label quality: overlap-only criterion, 65.8% accuracy, no coordinate error, impact untested.
Diversity and web-scale claims lack app/OS/channel statistics.
Table totals and denominators do not reconcile.
Terminate accuracy regression not discussed.
Licence/PII handling one sentence; typed strings stored verbatim.
Unclear Stage-1 input format and how task goals are supplied.
'Cost-effective' without cost figures.
Closest prior tutorial-to-trajectory work (TongUI etc.) missing; positioning thin.
Novelty application-level; mechanism is VPT's.
No component ablation of pipeline parts.
Latent-action alternatives to supervised IDM not discussed.
'Unsupervised' is a terminology stretch given labelled IDM data.
No numerical comparison with open agents (OpenCUA, AGUVIS, UI-TARS).
'Hundreds of applications' unsupported; OS composition not given.
No analysis of which data component matters; token-matched control missing.
'Unsupervised' and 'no manual annotation' claims overstated.
'High fidelity' contradicts 65.8% manual accuracy.
'True test-time scaling' claimed from one run.
Wrong cross-references, typos, inconsistent names and arithmetic slips.
Related work thin.
No limitations section.
Headline gain not isolated to video supervision; needs token-matched control and monologue ablation.
Any-overlap detection criterion cannot support millisecond-precision claim.
No automatic parameterization metric though held-out logs allow pixel error.
Low label accuracy under lenient plausibility review contradicts 'high fidelity'.
Recall 0.70 overall and 0.08 for press; many actions missing.
Effect of label noise on training not studied.
50-step results single runs; test-time scaling gain small.
Data-scaling curve has three single-run points.
No external reference to comparable open agents.
No grounding benchmark despite grounding claims.
Reporting inconsistencies in table totals and denominators.
Terminate accuracy regression ignored in selective reading of Table 5.
Minor numeric, cross-reference and typographic slips.

P.summary: Effect of parameter-label errors on agent performance unstudied.
Poor recall for keyboard actions and its impact.
Data corpus and manifests not released.
Mobile and non-English scope not addressed.

Q.summary: Keystroke actions missing from mined data.
Diversity claims unsupported; OS/app/channel composition unreported.
Low absolute success vs quality claims.
Gain confounded with tokens/compute; no token-matched control or component ablation.
Test-time scaling claim from single runs.
Label quality evaluation weak (overlap-only, no pixel error).
Stage-1 inputs and task goals unclear.
Missing closest prior work; thin related work.
